title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十二章 蓬莱云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十三章 反击
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
王文卿向来从容淡定，泰山崩于前而色不变，从未如此忘形。众道士见状大喜，围拢再看，顿时又爆起一片惊呼。
许宣从人群间隙望去，心中一震，难以相信自己的眼睛。
那张图长近六尺，五彩斑斓，画的虽仍是地理海图，却比先前平添了许多山川岛屿、凶禽怪兽。被灯火映照，幻光流离，但见江海汹汹奔流，波涛起伏；鸟兽盘旋飞舞，破浪腾空。不像是画，倒像是皮纸中镶嵌着活生生的情景。
金国小王爷亦大为骇异。他自恃无所不藏，却何曾见过这等会“动”的图画？瞠目结舌了好一会儿，才道：“这……这是什么东西？国师说的……说的足可覆灭南朝的秘密便是此图？”
林灵素嘿然道：“历朝历代的兴亡、阴阳五行之奥秘，尽在于此，何止区区一个狗屁赵宋？”
王文卿双眸光芒闪烁，微笑道：“他说得不错。这张‘炼天石图’是帝女娲采太古青龙的鳞皮，用五色石的彩墨亲手绘制而成，又叫‘青龙皮图’。‘炼天石图’共有五幅，分别绘制在青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四大神兽与中土混沌兽的皮骨之上，合在一处，才是真正的‘炼天石图’。”
舱内哄然，许宣心底又是一震，看来之前在扬子江上，林灵素所说的那些话竟是真的！
女娲补天的故事可谓妇孺皆知。
相传太古时代，伏羲化羽之后，凶兽频出，叛军四起，就连西北角的天柱山也被水神撞断，乃至天崩地裂，九州大乱。
女娲采五色石补住天裂，又用剩下的五色石镇伏了青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四大凶兽，平定了四海之乱。青龙属木，木生离火，此图以它鳞皮制成，难怪能倍增火势，而自身分毫无损。
金国鞑子最敬女娲，每年春分日必定要祭祀女娲、伏羲、青帝三位大神，听说此画是女娲所绘，无不凛然变色，纷纷伏身拜倒。
那小王爷也伏地磕了三个头，起身肃然道：“敢问国师，五色石上藏了什么秘密，与历朝历代的兴亡有什么相关？”语气恭敬，显然再无怀疑。
王文卿道：“阴阳和合，乃生万物；五行生克，方有四季。世间一切兴衰更迭，全都源于阴阳五行的变化，各朝各代的更替自然也不例外。比如周朝尚红，以火为德，行的是火运。
“秦始皇吞并列国后，自称水德，以水克火，因此得了周朝天下。然而实际上，秦国地处西方，行的乃是金运，能成大统，是因为周朝国运早已凋敝，那一丁点残余的‘火德’，反倒有助于冶炼‘金德’。
“再往后推演，五行火克金，金生水，水复克火。这就是为什么金德的秦国会被南方的楚人所灭，而火德的楚霸王又会败于秦国亭长刘邦之手，最终让尚水的汉朝得了天下。
“汉高祖为了让各国信服，自称得天佑，斩白蛇。所谓‘白蛇’，暗指的便是秦国的‘金德王运’。但汉朝既是水德，分明由金而生，又岂会克之？不过是想抹煞项羽的功劳罢了。”
这五德更替的理论许宣闻所未闻，大感好奇，听到“白蛇”二字，眼前登时闪过白素贞那清丽绝俗的脸容，心中又是“咯噔”一跳，黯然刺痛。
王文卿道：“秦国自称‘水德’，刘邦死后，汉代皇帝为了自圆其说，又改称为‘土德’，尚黄色。刘秀灭王莽，光复汉室，五行火生土，火有重生之功，因此改为‘火德’。到了三国时，刘备号称正统，也称火德。而曹丕迫使汉帝禅让，五行火生土，魏国便成了‘土德’，尚黄。吴国地处东方，孙权又打出旗号要锄灭曹魏，匡扶汉室，便根据五行木克土，立木为德……”
顿了顿，嘴角露出一丝淡淡的讥嘲之色，又道：“却不知阴阳五行乃天地运行之道，是什么，便是什么，岂会因你信口附会而更改？秦国号称水德，实行金运，所以被楚人所灭，为汉朝所替代。汉朝称过水、土、火三德，实际却是水运，五行土克水，故而才被黄巾军杀得七零八落，国运凋零。曹操之所以大破黄巾军，正因为他是木德之身，魏国当行木运。也正因如此，魏国最终才会被以金为德的晋朝所篡。”
那金国小王爷听得似懂非懂，皱眉道：“既然是天意昭昭，无可更改，国师又为何说这图中所藏的秘密，可以帮我大金夺取南朝天下？”

王文卿微微一笑，道：“常言道‘命不可改，运可改’。国家行什么运，便要看社稷神庙里，供的是什么神器，祭的又是何方神兽。赵宋受禅于周，周朝尚青，五行木生火，所以赵官家以火为德。大金国行的是土运，火生土，虽然可以处处受益于赵宋，却很难取而代之。王爷若想改国运，就需找到水属的神器、神兽，供于神庙之中……”
那些金国将士个个云里雾中，早被绕得晕了。
一个大胡子听得不耐，忍不住截口叫道：“国师说来说去，忒也啰嗦。这图里到底有什么秘密，快些讲来便是……”被那小王爷猛一喝斥，悻悻住口。
王文卿此时心情大畅，丝毫不以为意，道：“女娲补天之后，为了防止叛乱卷土重来，将剩余的五色石炼化出五座大山，按照木克土、土克水、水克火、火克金、金克木的顺序，将混沌凶兽与青龙、玄武、朱雀、白虎四大神兽，连同各族负隅顽抗的头领、众多神器，全都镇伏在这五座山下。
“据说那五座神山日增百丈，越来越高，最后参天摩云，变为擎天四柱。一直到几千年后，封镇‘混沌’的不周山才被共工一头撞断，引得天河倾泻，洪灾泛滥。所幸还有四大天柱支撑，没酿成当年的天裂之祸。也亏得共工撞断不周山，世人才得以发现五座神山中所藏的奥秘。
“原来女娲为了补天，神亏气竭，自知即将登仙化羽，便将毕生所领悟的天地妙法全都刻在了那块补天所用的五色石上，并用五大神兽的皮骨画了五幅地图，藏于这五座天柱山下，只要将这五幅地图拼在一起，就能找到补天石。而藏在不周山下的地图，便是这幅‘青龙皮图’。”
说着，手指在图上轻轻一叩。水光荡漾，一片连绵的巍峨山脉焕发出淡淡的金光，隐隐可见“蓬莱”二字。
许宣一震，失声道：“这幅图所画的山是蓬莱？”
王文卿瞄了他一眼，淡淡道：“不错。除了被撞断的不周山，以及镇伏‘白虎’的昆仑山，另外三座神山便是‘瀛洲’、‘方丈’与‘蓬莱’。山山相关，图图相引。五行金克木，蓬莱山上镇伏青龙之处，藏着‘白虎’的毛皮所制的‘白虎皮图’，按图索骥，就能找到昆仑山上封镇‘白虎’之处；而五行火克金，封镇‘白虎’的地方，又藏着‘朱雀翎图’，能带你找着镇伏朱雀神鸟的‘赢洲’；如此类推，藏于‘赢洲’的‘玄武骨图’，则能让你找到封镇‘玄武’的‘方丈’；而‘方丈’那儿所藏的‘混沌骨图’，又正好指向了封镇‘混沌’的不周山。有了这五图合成的‘炼天石图’，你便能找着补天石，翻手为云，覆手为雨，再没有任何做不到之事！”
那些金国将士对这几座神山一无所知，听他说什么五行生克，更是丈二和尚摸不着头脑，茫然不解。许宣、小青却不啻于焦雷轰顶，张大了嘴，面面相觑，震撼难言。
昆仑自古被称作第一神山，相传王母娘娘便居住于山上。而蓬莱、方丈、瀛洲也一直被视为“道教三大神山”，相传一在海中，一在山中，一在天上。
早在战国时，便有方士宣称见过这三座神山，山上除了奇花异草、珍禽异兽，还有神仙与不死药。在这些方士怂恿之下，齐威王、燕昭王、秦始皇、汉武帝……历朝帝王都曾先后派人入海寻找，可惜一无所获。想不到这些神山竟然是女娲的五色石变化而成！
那金国小王爷听了仍大感诧异，道：“国师所住的仙山不就是蓬莱么？既已住了这么久，又何必再找？”
林灵素哈哈大笑道：“他住的若是蓬莱，老子就住在天庭了！”
众道士怒目而视，脸上微有尴尬之色。
王文卿倒是淡然自若，道：“贫道所居的山岛虽在东海之上，也名为蓬莱，却不是帝女神石所化。不周山撞倒之后，这幅‘青龙皮图’秘密辗转了几千年，数易人手。就贫道所知，得到这幅图的几个人，不是称霸天下、一统四海，便是修成正果，登入仙界。”
许宣心中怦怦剧跳，他小时曾听程仲甫说过，女娲所补之天裂，也是凡人升入仙界的“云门”。云门既封，从此再无人能以肉身飞度升天。后世的修真惟有打通泥丸宫，才能元神离窍，魂登仙界。

content_en:
Wang Wenqing had always been calm and composed, and his expression remained unchanged despite the collapse of Mount Tai. He had never been so carried away. The Taoist priests were overjoyed when they saw this. They gathered around to take another look, and suddenly there was another exclamation of exclamation.
Xu Xuan looked from the gap in the crowd, his heart was shocked and he couldn't believe his eyes.
The map was nearly six feet long and colorful. Although it was still a geographical map, it included many more mountains, islands, ferocious birds and monsters than before. Illuminated by the lights, the phantom light wanders away, and you can see the river and sea rushing violently, the waves undulating; birds and beasts circling and dancing, breaking the waves and soaring into the sky. It doesn't look like a painting, but like a living scene embedded in the paper.
The young prince of Jin Kingdom was also shocked. He believed that he had everything to hide, but he had never seen such a "moving" picture before? After being stunned for a while, he said: "What... what is this? The Imperial Master said... that the secret that could destroy the Southern Dynasty is this picture?"
Lin Lingsu said happily: "The rise and fall of the past dynasties, the secrets of Yin Yang and the Five Elements are all here, not just a piece of crap Zhao Song?"
Wang Wenqing's eyes flickered and he said with a smile: "He is right. This 'Heaven Refining Stone Picture' was drawn by the Emperor Nuwa using the scales of an ancient blue dragon and painted with colored ink of five-color stones. It is also called the 'Blue Dragon Skin Picture'. There are five 'Sky Refining Stone Pictures', which were drawn on the skin and bones of the four great beasts of Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, Xuanwu and the Middle Earth Chaos Beast. When combined together, it is the real 'Sky Refining Stone Picture'."
There was an uproar in the cabin, and Xu Xuan was shocked again. It seemed that what Lin Lingsu said on the Yangtze River before was actually true!
The story of Nuwa mending the sky is well known to women and children.
According to legend, in the ancient times, after Fuxi became a feather, ferocious beasts appeared frequently and rebels rose up everywhere. Even Tianzhu Mountain in the northwest corner was broken by the water god, causing the sky to collapse and the earth to fall apart, causing chaos in Kyushu.
Nuwa collected five-color stones to repair the cracks in the sky, and used the remaining five-color stones to subdue the four ferocious beasts of Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu, and quelled the chaos in the world. The blue dragon belongs to wood, and wood generates fire. This picture is made of its scales. No wonder it can multiply the power of fire without losing any of its own parts.
The Tatars of the Jin Dynasty respected Nuwa the most, and they must sacrifice to the three great gods Nuwa, Fuxi and Qingdi on the spring equinox every year. When they heard that this painting was painted by Nuwa, they all changed their colors in awe and fell down to worship her.
The young prince also kowtowed three times, stood up and said solemnly: "May I ask the master, what secrets are hidden on the five-color stone, and how is it related to the rise and fall of past dynasties?" His tone was respectful, and he obviously had no doubts.
Wang Wenqing said: "The harmony of yin and yang gives birth to all things; the five elements create and restrain each other to create four seasons. All the rise and fall of the world are due to the changes of yin and yang and the five elements, and the replacement of each dynasty is no exception. For example, the Zhou Dynasty promoted red, regarded fire as a virtue, and practiced fire luck.
“After Qin Shihuang annexed other countries, he claimed to be the virtue of water and used water to defeat fire, thus conquering the Zhou Dynasty. However, in fact, the Qin State is located in the west, and its fortune is golden. It can become a great unification because the national fortune of the Zhou Dynasty has long withered, and the remaining "fire virtue" actually helps to smelt the "gold virtue".
"Going further, the five elements fire overcomes metal, metal generates water, and water overcomes fire. This is why the Qin State of Jin De was destroyed by the Chu people in the south, and the Chu Overlord of Fire Deed was defeated by the Qin Pavilion Chief Liu Bang, and finally the Han Dynasty of Shang Shui conquered the world.
“In order to convince other countries, the Emperor of the Han Dynasty killed the White Snake, claiming to be blessed by God. The so-called "white snake" alludes to the "Jin De Wang Lun" of Qin. But since the Han Dynasty was a water virtue, clearly derived from gold, how could it overcome it? He just wanted to erase Xiang Yu's achievements. "
Xu Xuan had never heard of this theory of the replacement of the five virtues, and was very curious. When he heard the word "White Snake", Bai Suzhen's beautiful and elegant face flashed before his eyes, and his heart skipped a beat again, feeling sad.
Wang Wenqing said: "The Qin State called itself 'Shui De'. After Liu Bang's death, the emperor of the Han Dynasty changed the name to 'Tude', which was still yellow, in order to justify his theory. Liu Xiu destroyed Wang Mang and restored the Han Dynasty. The five elements of fire gave rise to earth. Fire has the power of rebirth.Therefore it was changed to ‘Fire Virtue’. By the time of the Three Kingdoms, Liu Bei was known as orthodox, also known as Huode. However, Cao Pi forced the Han Emperor to abdicate, and the Five Elements of Fire gave birth to earth, and the Wei state became "Tu De" and respected Huang. The Kingdom of Wu is located in the east, and Sun Quan once again raised his banner to destroy Cao Wei and support the Han Dynasty, so he followed the five elements of wood to conquer the earth, and established trees as virtue..."
After a pause, there was a hint of sarcasm at the corner of his mouth, and then he said: "But I don't know that Yin Yang and the Five Elements are the way of the movement of heaven and earth. What it is is what it is. How can it be changed just because you follow your words? The Qin State was known as the Water Virtue and practiced the movement of gold, so it was destroyed by the Chu people and replaced by the Han Dynasty. The Han Dynasty claimed to have the three virtues of water, earth, and fire, but in fact it was water transport. The five elements of earth defeated water, so they were killed by the Yellow Turban Army and the country's destiny withered. The reason why Cao Cao defeated the Yellow Turban Army was precisely because he was a man of wooden virtue, and the Wei State should have good luck. It is precisely because of this that the Wei Kingdom was eventually usurped by the Jin Dynasty, which regarded gold as its virtue. "
The young prince of the Jin Kingdom seemed to understand, and frowned: "Since it is God's will that cannot be changed, why did the Imperial Master say that the secret hidden in this picture can help me, Jin, seize the world of the Southern Dynasty? "
Wang Wenqing smiled slightly and said: "As the saying goes, 'fate cannot be changed, but luck can.' The luck of the country depends on what kind of artifacts are offered in the Sheji Temple and what kind of sacred beasts are sacrificed. Zhao Song received Zen from the Zhou Dynasty, and the Zhou Dynasty was still young. The five elements of wood produced fire, so the Zhao Guan family regarded fire as virtue. The Kingdom of Jin is run by earth, and fire generates earth. Although it can benefit from Zhao and Song in every aspect, it is difficult to replace it. If the prince wants to change the destiny of the country, he needs to find water-type artifacts and beasts and offer them to the temple..."
The soldiers of the Jin Kingdom were all in a fog, and had long been stunned.
A bearded man couldn't bear to hear it and couldn't help shouting: "The Imperial Master is very long-winded in his talk. What secret is there in this picture? Let me tell you quickly..." He was scolded by the young prince and stopped in anger.
Wang Wenqing was in a happy mood at this time and did not take it seriously at all. He said: "After Nuwa mended the sky, in order to prevent the rebellion from coming back, she refined the remaining five-color stones into five mountains. According to the rules, wood overcomes earth, earth controls water, and water In the order of overcoming fire, fire overcoming metal, and metal overcoming wood, the chaotic beasts and the four divine beasts of Qinglong, Xuanwu, Suzaku, and White Tiger, as well as the stubborn leaders of each tribe and numerous artifacts, were all suppressed under these five mountains.
"It is said that the five sacred mountains increased by hundreds of feet day by day, getting higher and higher, and finally reached the sky and covered the clouds, becoming the four pillars of the sky. It was not until thousands of years later that Mount Buzhou, which sealed off the "Chaos", was broken by Gonggong, causing the Milky Way to pour out and floods. Fortunately, there were still four pillars supporting it, which did not cause the disaster of the sky. It was also thanks to Gonggong that he broke Mount Buzhou, and the world was able to discover the secrets hidden in the five sacred mountains.
"It turns out that Nuwa was exhausted in order to mend the sky. Knowing that she was about to ascend to immortality and become a feather, she carved all the magic of heaven and earth she had learned throughout her life on the five-color stone used to mend the sky. She also drew five maps with the skin and bones of the five great beasts and hid them under the five Tianzhu Mountains. As long as these five maps are put together, you can find the stone to mend the sky. And the map hidden under Buzhou Mountain is this 'Blue Dragon Skin Map'. "
As he spoke, he tapped his finger on the picture. The water is rippling, and a stretch of towering mountains glows with a faint golden light, and the word "Penglai" is faintly visible.
Xu Xuan was shocked and lost his voice: "Is the mountain in this picture Penglai? "
Wang Wenqing glanced at him and said lightly: "Not bad. In addition to Buzhou Mountain, which was broken off, and Kunlun Mountain, which suppressed the "White Tiger", the other three sacred mountains are "Yingzhou", "Abbott" and "Penglai". Mountains and mountains are related, and pictures and pictures lead to each other. The five elements of metal overcome wood. The place where the green dragon is subdued on Penglai Mountain is hidden. The "White Tiger Skin Picture" made of the fur of the "white tiger" is hidden. If you follow the picture, you can find the place where the "white tiger" is sealed on the Kunlun Mountain.; By analogy, the 'Xuanwu Bone Map' hidden in 'Yingzhou' will allow you to find the 'Abbot' who sealed off 'Xuanwu'; and the 'Chaos Bone Map' hidden there in the 'Abbott' just points to Buzhou Mountain where 'Chaos' was sealed off. With the ‘Sky Refining Stone Diagram’ synthesized from these five diagrams, you can find the Sky Mending Stone, turn your hand into clouds, turn your hand into rain, and there is nothing you can’t do! "
Those soldiers of the Jin Kingdom knew nothing about these sacred mountains. When he heard what he said about the five elements, Monk Zhanger was even more confused and confused. Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing, on the other hand, looked at each other in shock with their mouths wide open.
Kunlun has been known as the first sacred mountain since ancient times. According to legend, the Queen Mother lived on the mountain. Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou have always been regarded as the "three sacred mountains of Taoism". According to legend, one is in the sea, one is in the mountain, and the other is in the sky.
As early as the Warring States Period, some alchemists claimed to have seen these three sacred mountains. In addition to exotic flowers and plants, rare birds and animals, there were also gods and elixirs on the mountains. Under the instigation of these alchemists, King Wei of Qi, King Yan Zhao, Qin Shihuang, Emperor Wu of Han... all the emperors of the past dynasties sent people into the sea to search for it, but unfortunately found nothing. Unexpectedly, these sacred mountains were transformed from Nuwa's five-color stones!
The young prince of the Jin Kingdom was still very surprised after hearing this and said: "Isn't the fairy mountain where the imperial master lives Penglai? Since you have lived here for so long, why bother looking for it again? "
Lin Lingsu laughed loudly and said: "If he lived in Penglai, I would live in Heaven! "
The Taoist priests glared angrily, with slight embarrassment on their faces.
Wang Wenqing was calm and composed, and said: "Although the mountain island where Pindao lives is located above the East China Sea and is also called Penglai, it is not made of the stone of the goddess of the emperor. After being knocked down by Buzhou Mountain, this 'Blue Dragon Skin Picture' had been secretly circulated for thousands of years and changed hands several times. As far as Pindao knows, the few people who got this picture either dominated the world and unified the world, or they achieved enlightenment and entered the immortal world. "
Xu Xuan's heart was pounding. When he was a child, he heard Cheng Zhongfu say that the crack in the sky that Nuwa repaired was also the "Cloud Gate" for mortals to ascend to the immortal world. Now that Yunmen is sealed, no one can fly to heaven in the flesh from now on. Only by opening up the Niwan Palace in later generations can the soul leave the body and ascend to the immortal world.
